title: plugin-security: a master-detail write refusal names the master in the default language for a regional request tag (en-US), while /meta and objectql name it in en
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRB34k9WUWeGpRnVNm

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding from the #36466 os-dev report (comment 7087890193, PR #36561). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.

## What the user sees

In a deployment authored in English (`i18n.sourceLocale: 'en'`) whose default and fallback locale is `zh-CN` and that holds an `en` pack, a user whose browser sends `en-US` is refused a write by the master-detail edit gate with a message that names the master object in Chinese (`… the 合同 …`), while the same request reads `Contract` from `/meta` (after PR #36561) and from objectql's refusals. A request for `en` names it `Contract`.

## Why (read from source; measured by the #36466 dev in a scratch test, not committed)

- `denialLocaleOf` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` returns the raw request tag; its `resolveBundleLocale` call only tests whether the built-in catalog has text.
- `denialLabels` hands that raw tag to `translateObject`, unnegotiated, so `en-US` finds no pack and walks the chain to `zh-CN`.
- objectql (`negotiatedMessageLocale`), plugin-approvals (`negotiatedReaderLocale`) and, after PR #36561, `/meta` (`metaTranslateOptions`) negotiate the tag against `i18n.getLocales()` with `resolveBundleLocale` first.

Measured: same deployment shape, engine insert refused by the master-edit gate → `userMessage` names `Contract` for `en`, `合同` for `en-US`, `Contract` for `fr-FR`.

## Fix direction

Negotiate the label locale against `i18n.getLocales()` with `resolveBundleLocale` before `translateObject`, as the other readers do. Same family as #36466 (whose acceptance — "`/meta` and the server-side readers name an object with the same label" — this reader still fails).

## Reader

`packages/plugins/plugin-security` (`domain:server`). Reach: every user with a regional browser tag in a deployment whose default language differs from its authored one, on any master-detail write refusal.

Suggested-grade: p2 · same rule as #36466 (two doors disagree on one label for one request).

Dedupe: open-issue search `denialLabels locale` → 1 (#36466, the parent of this finding), `denialLocaleOf` → 1 (#36466), `plugin-security en-US` → 3 (#36466; #35384, which moves approval and audit texts onto `translateObject` and does not cover the security refusal; the triage seat post). No open card for this reader.
